defs.def: the part that sticks out and can be moved at the back of the body of a bird, an animal or a fish 尾；尾巴

ex.s: The movements have ____62____ (describe) names like “holding the bowl” and “grabbing the bird’s tail.”
ex.t: 这些招式有着____（描述性的）名字，比如“抱碗”和“揽雀尾”。

ex.s: Scientists in Louisiana were so concerned that they decided to pay hunters $5 a tail.
ex.t: 路易斯安那州的科学家们非常担心，以至于决定付给猎人每条尾巴5美元。

defs.def: having the type of tail mentioned 构成形容词
the back part of a plane, spacecraft, etc. 尾部；后部

ex.s: Hunters bring in more than 300,000 nutria tails a year, so part of Mouton’s job these days is trying to promote fur.
ex.t: 猎人每年带回超过30万条海狸鼠尾巴，所以Mouton现在的工作的一部分就是推广皮草。

defs.def: a part of sth that sticks out at the back like a tail 尾状后部；尾状物

ex.s: Attracted/Attracting by mermaids since she was a child, Hannah Fraser created her first tail when she was only nine years old.
ex.t: 自小被美人鱼吸引的汉娜·弗雷泽，在年仅九岁时就制作了她的第一条尾巴。

ex.s: When she climbed the bank toward us and shook out her tail, we realized our error: it was a wolf.
ex.t: 当她爬上河岸朝我们走来、抖开尾巴时，我们意识到自己搞错了：那是一头狼。

ex.s: A half-dozen others, evidently grown pups, sprang from the willows and all joined in a welcoming melee of wagging tails and playful maulings.
ex.t: 另外六七只显然已长大的幼狼从柳丛中窜出，全都加入这场摇着尾巴、嬉闹撕咬的欢迎混战。

ex.s: It is perhaps the longest species of monkey and also one of the heaviest: a male’s body length can reach 50–115 cm, with a tail length of 45–84 cm, while it can weigh 21– 45 kg; a female’s body weight can range 12–25 kg.
ex.t: 它或许是最长的猴类，也是最重的之一：雄性体长可达50—115厘米，尾长45—84厘米，体重可达21—45千克；雌性体重则在12—25千克之间。

defs.def: the last part of sth that is moving away from you （离去事物的）末尾部分
a long jacket divided at the back below the waist into two pieces that become narrower at the bottom, worn by men at very formal events 燕尾服；男式晚礼服

ex.s: Background information The parakeet is a kind of small to medium-sized parrot with brightly-coloured and long tail feathers.
ex.t: 背景信息 长尾鹦鹉是一种中小型鹦鹉，长着色彩鲜艳的长尾羽。

defs.def: the side of a coin that does not have a picture of the head of a person on it, used as one choice when a coin is tossed to decide sth 硬币反面，硬币文面（没有头像的一面）
a person who is sent to follow sb secretly and find out information about where that person goes, what they do, etc. 盯梢人；暗探
